cells.value: Fresh post-timestamp Composio discovery/schema cluster • Internal evidence→isolated candidate→same eval→holdout/regression→KEEP/KILL.
Freeze JAVAR-BASELINE-001: model/provider, harness/Hermes, rules, skills/config versions.

Freeze split/scorecard/budget; reuse golden evals; save replay reference. Harness experiment: freeze model/provider; vary harness. Model bake-off: freeze harness/evaluator; vary model/provider. Never vary both and claim causal attribution.
Extend existing Observatory with shared structured intake from every active role, including Director. See FAILURES & BLOCKERS.
Version-linked model/provider/tokens/cost/latency/tools/retries/outcome; event/mission/agent IDs and trace pointers. Deduplicate delivery; detect missing reports and buffer collector outages.
Distinguish failures, legitimate blockers, corrections and UNKNOWNs; cluster a real failure using expected versus observed evidence.
Composio discovery/schema root cause remains unproven. Confirmed recurring or high-impact failures become reviewed eval candidates; permission stops are preserved.
Query internal knowledge first; then Exa, primary docs/source and implementation evidence.
Save supporting + contradicting sources, scope and testable hypothesis. Unsupported idea cannot be called proven.

STEERING = prompts, instructions, rules, routing guidance. CAPABILITY = tools, skills, memory, runtime/harness capabilities. Prefer one bounded category/change; preserve production and frozen holdout.
Exact versions and stop/rollback. One variable at a time; no automatic or endless tuning.

Run baseline and candidate against the same frozen evaluator/scorecard. For important stochastic evaluations, use at least 3 repeated runs under the same frozen conditions for each compared condition; report mean + standard deviation.

Measure quality and cost/latency. Accept a quality win, or cost win at unchanged quality floor; no invented target. A lucky single run cannot produce KEEP. UNKNOWN ≠ PASS. Deterministic checks with no possible variance need no repetition.
Run untouched holdout + existing regression checks.
Final holdout answers stay outside optimizer context. AHO iteration validation is not our untouched final test. Any critical regression blocks KEEP; production unchanged.
Director/reviewer decides keep or kill from receipts.
Independent negative check + proven kill/rollback. Candidate success is not production release authority.
Link failure → eval → experiment → fix in existing history. Prime receives distilled proven lessons; raw events/traces remain in the operational store.
Save versions, sources, result, cost, recovery, decision and next action. Fresh controller retrieves current findings; recurring regression retained with explicit version/retirement history.

BOUNDARIES • Freeze→measure→KEEP/KILL→record. AHO is optional after Gate1 and competes against Astra/manual process. Events/Manus/Aperture/training/extra screens are not mission dependencies. No automatic production promotion or unbounded spend.
